releases.changelogText:
Ace Editor 2.49.0 brings together the 55 versions after 2.0.2.

- Script completion follows the AutoJs6 6.8.0 API: bundled declarations @sm003/autojs6-dts 4.87.0, the members and returned objects of Node.js Runtime 2.1.0 and Bun Runtime 0.22.0, imgui and $imgui with AutoJs6 Plugin ImGui 1.18.x in Rhino scripts, and the AutoJs6 APIs of the Python, Lua, Java and Kotlin runtimes.
- Requires Android 7.0 / API 24 and AutoJs6 build 5352 or later, as 2.0.2 does. The latest public AutoJs6 release, 6.7.0 (build 3804), is below that requirement.
- Five signed packages are provided: arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, x86, x86_64 and universal.
- Validation: the JVM tests, lint and the 84 instrumentation tests of the GitHub workflow on an API 35 emulator; signature, CRC, ABI and 16 KB alignment gates; and, with the final arm64-v8a package on 22120RN86C (API 33), the host-side release smoke test and the 8 host loading tests.

See [validation details](https://github.com/SuperMonster003/AutoJs6-Plugin-Ace-Editor/blob/master/docs/development/release-2.49.0.md) for the artifact hashes. SHA-256 sums are also attached.

releases.changelogText:
Bun Runtime 0.22.0

Official APKs signed with the AutoJs6 release certificate.

Source: `a38fd3714f6d9e46d3386996883bd46c1292d69e`

Published release.

- Feature: Bun.file and node:fs can read and write shared storage (such as /sdcard): the plugin now declares "All files access", which must be enabled in system settings; when a script reports EACCES / EPERM for shared storage, AutoJs6 shows a prompt with a link to that settings page, at most once per execution, without changing the error itself
- Feature: The host util, species, s13n, cvt, fmt, jsox, pinyin and global data functions match AutoJs6 scripts
- Feature: The host colors / Color, files, zip, mime, timing recorder, storages and mediainfo match AutoJs6 scripts; global open, Color, axios, dayjs, pangu, cheerio and i18n
- Feature: The host app, shell and shizuku modules and ShellProcess match AutoJs6 scripts, returning results as Promise values
- Feature: The host autojs, installer, memory, settings, sysprops, powerManager, engines, plugins, dialogs.build and extended notifications members match AutoJs6 scripts; host.global.install() installs global system functions and R on globalThis
- Feature: The host device, sensors and media match AutoJs6 scripts
- Feature: The host ui, floaty, web, compose, terminal, toast and console match AutoJs6 scripts, with interfaces displayed in AutoJs6; the new terminal.control, floaty.control, floaty.raw and floaty.touch authorizations are required
- Feature: The host automator, auto, keys, ocr, barcode, qrcode, yolo, threads, continuation, timers, selector and events key/touch listeners match AutoJs6 scripts; the new accessibility.service, events.touch, events.key.intercept, ocr.control, barcode.control and yolo.control authorizations are required
- Feature: The host colors.theme, gallery (requires 3-Maple Image), files.batchRename (requires Batch Rename), speech.speaker, speech.diarize, speech.detectLanguage and speech.tag; the new theme.control, gallery.control and batchrename.control authorizations are required and disabled by default; independently signed packaged apps cannot call 3-Maple Image or Batch Rename
- Feature: Flow objects provide await() and sync(timeout), both returning Promise values, used as await chain.sync(); exceeding timeout (milliseconds) rejects with TIMEOUT while the flow continues, as in AutoJs6 scripts
- Fix: A terminal session waitFor immediately followed by write could miss rapidly echoed output and time out
- Fix: Calling web.cancelFileChooser() immediately after chooseFiles() could leave the file chooser open
- Fix: Relative paths in files.open, files.toFile and zip were not resolved against the script directory, preventing files alongside the script from being found
- Fix: shell.exec could occasionally fail with ERR_STREAM_DESTROYED when a command finished very quickly
- Fix: WIDTH / HEIGHT and setScreenMetrics scaling did not use the full screen dimensions
- Improvement: The maximum number of host authorizations per request increased from 64 to 128
- Improvement: ocr results include a read-only extras object, and option declarations include recognition options such as useOpenCL and mergeLine
- Improvement: Type declarations for host.speech.models.list include updateAvailable and latestVersionCode to indicate whether an installed model has a newer version (requires 3-Macaw Speech 1.4.0 or later)
- Feature: ai.agent task controls, events and registered-script context/results for Node.js, Bun and Workers, with explicit authorization for packaged applications
- Feature: AI text generation, streaming, model catalog and persistent sessions for Node.js, Bun and Workers, with cancellation and per-app consent in 3-Stone AI for packaged apps
- Feature: Flow within/scope with inherited search roots, compass navigation and typed result projections, plus press/swipe/gesture/gestures overloads for Node.js, Bun and Workers
- Feature: Flow advanced clicks, scrolling, text entry, list collection and real event waits for Node.js, Bun and Workers, with subscription readiness, snapshot validation and cancellation
- Fix: Bun UI event waits blocking other host calls and causing asynchronous Flow verification to time out
- Feature: Flow asynchronous chains and condition/stability waits for Node.js, Bun and Workers, with branch cancellation, step retries and host UI snapshots
- Feature: Bun mail.control: Mail account connections, message operations, attachments and mailbox watches, with cancellation and Worker cleanup
- Fix: Missing tts.control, speech.control and epub.control values in the Bun capability type
- Feature: Bun: EPUB book reading, resource export, search and reader sessions with events
- Feature: Speech recognition and model management APIs for Node.js, Bun and Workers, with WAV/PCM, dictation and wake sessions, model installation/import, synthesis and cancellation cleanup
- Feature: Text-to-speech APIs for Node.js, Bun and Workers, with engine and voice queries, speech, silence, audio file synthesis and task events
- Feature: Java callbacks, generated subclasses and JAR/DEX loading for Node.js, Bun and Workers, with Promise results, superclass calls and execution cleanup
- Feature: Java/Android object interop for Node.js, Bun and Workers, including public constructors and members, arrays, exact long values, explicit overloads and application Context handles
- Feature: Android object helpers for Node.js, Bun and Workers, including Paint, ColorStateList, theme colors and FileProvider URIs
- Feature: Persistent calendar and IntentTask APIs for Node.js and Bun, with daily, weekly, monthly, yearly, one-shot, countdown and broadcast tasks
- Feature: Device controls and dialogs for Bun and Node.js Workers, including brightness, volume and independent window cleanup
- Feature: Host event observers and notifications for Bun and Node.js Workers, with independent subscription and notification cleanup
- Feature: Host Shell streaming, Shizuku authorization and process cleanup for Bun, Node.js and Workers
- Feature: Sensor sampling and subscriptions for Bun and Node.js Workers with cancellation and automatic listener cleanup
- Feature: Host database/sqlite APIs for Bun and Node.js Workers with parameterized queries, transactions and persistence
- Feature: Bun file and persistent storage APIs with separate host-file grants and shared Node.js storage
- Feature: Bun accessibility, app operations and clipboard APIs aligned with the Node.js interfaces, with independent grants and packaged-app support
- Feature: WebView screen sharing adapter, foreground-service audio capture and native background camera recording in Node.js/Bun, including Node Workers

releases.changelogText:
MCP Server 1.2.0

Official APKs signed with the AutoJs6 release certificate.

Source: `8fef1ba9ec10a288df934342e12c25408b74eddb`

Published release.

- Hint: The plugin tools and script_catalog / script_registered_run rely on host support that ships with the AutoJs6 6.8.0 release; without it, or without the matching plugin, they do not appear and the other tools work as before (the minimum host stays build 5298)
- Feature: Six plugin tool groups with their own switches (OCR text recognition, barcode recognition, OpenCV image and color search, Pinyin and Pinyin4j conversion, MediaInfo media metadata): their tools appear in the client tool list only while the matching AutoJs6 plugin is installed and enabled, the list updates itself after a plugin is installed, removed or updated, and calling a tool whose plugin is missing explains why (PLUGIN_UNAVAILABLE); recognition calls that read the screen (image "screen") share the limit of 30 screenshots per minute per client with screen_capture, while image files on the phone are not counted
- Feature: ocr_recognize tool, which recognizes text on the phone screen or in an image file on the phone (needs an installed and enabled ML Kit, Paddle OCR or Rapid OCR plugin): image "screen" captures and recognizes inside AutoJs6, a path inside the working directory reads the file first; optional region crop and engine choice (automatic by default); results carry text, confidence and bounds (large files in their own pixels), and no image leaves the phone
- Feature: barcode_detect tool, which reads barcodes and QR codes on the phone screen or in an image file on the phone (needs an installed and enabled ML Kit Barcode plugin): image "screen" captures and detects inside AutoJs6, a path inside the working directory reads the file first; optional formats filter, region crop and maxResults limit; results carry the content, symbology and bounds (large files in their own pixels), and no image leaves the phone
- Feature: opencv_find_image, opencv_find_color and opencv_find_multi_colors tools, which find an image, a color or a multi-point color pattern on the phone screen or in an image file on the phone (need an installed and enabled OpenCV plugin): the template of the image search is an image in the working directory, and each match comes with its bounds, center and similarity; the color searches return the first matching pixel; region limits every search, and no image leaves the phone
- Feature: pinyin_convert and pinyin4j_convert tools, which convert Chinese text to pinyin (need an installed and enabled Pinyin or Pinyin4j plugin respectively): pinyin_convert reads whole words from a phrase dictionary, so characters with several readings usually come out right, with tone styles, first letters and a surname / place name mode; pinyin4j_convert works character by character and offers other romanizations such as Wade-Giles and Yale, tone marks or numbers, upper case, and every reading of each character
- Feature: mediainfo_read tool, which reads the format, duration, bit rates, codecs, resolution, channels, sampling rate and tags of an audio, video or image file on the phone (needs an installed and enabled MediaInfo plugin): the path is a file in the working directory, and the result carries a summary and every field of each track, optionally with the full text report
- Feature: "Allow reading shared storage" switch on the settings page (off by default), which lets the recognition, media and list / stat tools read absolute paths in shared storage, such as photos and downloads: absolute paths are refused until it is on, Android/data and Android/obb are never readable, and the other file tools stay in the working directory (AutoJs6 needs All files access)
- Feature: script_catalog and script_registered_run tools in the script group, which list and run the scripts the user registered for models in the AutoJs6 working directory (a script with an @agent header comment, or a project with an agent entry in project.json; AutoJs6 6.8.0 or later): the catalog shows each script's description, parameters, risk and whether to ask first; a run has AutoJs6 check the arguments against the registered parameters and fill in defaults, stops the script after its registered time, and returns the value the script reported and its newest console lines; the tools appear only when AutoJs6 grants them, and the model asks the user before running a script marked sensitive or confirm-first
- Feature: Tools that AutoJs6 plugins describe themselves (for example opencc_convert of the 3-Hanzi CC plugin for Chinese conversion; needs AutoJs6 6.8.0 or later): they appear in the tool list in one group per plugin; groups of official plugins are on by default, third-party plugins must be switched on under "Plugin tools" in the settings, and tools that write, delete or reach the network also need the second switch of their group; image arguments take "screen" or a path, directory arguments a directory path (such as a model directory), files a tool produces go under plugin-outputs in the working directory with the extension of their actual format, and their paths are returned (outputPaths chooses the place; tools such as extraction write a folder, which may exist already, keeping the files in it), with a preview for images up to 1 MiB; the list follows installs, removals and updates of plugins
- Feature: MCP device_start_remote_server tool starts AutoJs6 server mode on the phone (TCP 7347), reports listening status and connection count, and keeps existing connections on repeated calls; requires a supporting host and asks the user to grant local network access on the phone when missing
- Fix: Clients receiving dozens of repeated tools/list_changed notifications (one per tool) after a tool group was switched on the settings page
- Fix: Device evidence scripts starting a leftover debug test APK against the release app and crashing its process
- Improvement: The device_info tool and the autojs6://device/info resource gain a plugins field (AutoJs6 6.8.0 or later): the state of each plugin family, such as OCR, barcode, OpenCV, Pinyin, Pinyin4j, MediaInfo and offline docs (available / not installed / disabled / incompatible), the tools it brings and an install hint, so a model can tell the user what to install in the plugin center
- Improvement: The device_info tool and the autojs6://device/info resource gain a pluginTools field (AutoJs6 6.8.0 or later): the plugins that declare tools, their status, trust and group switches, whether each tool is listed, and what to do when tools are missing
- Improvement: With AutoJs6 6.8.0 build 5333 or later, the settings page notice about turned-off notifications says that pairing requests also appear while AutoJs6 is in the foreground
- Dependency: Upgrade AutoJs6 platform versions and native alignment build plugins 1.9.0 -> 1.9.7

APK checksums are in `SHA256SUMS`.

releases.changelogText:
Node.js Runtime 2.1.0

Official APKs signed with the AutoJs6 release certificate.

Source: `97ac555db66a373ee72a668ee7cda17e811f6a49`

Published release.

- Feature: The Node.js and Worker ui, floaty, web, compose, terminal and toast modules, plus console window controls, rawInput / input, match AutoJs6 scripts, with interfaces displayed in AutoJs6 and results returned as Promise values; using terminal requires declaring the new terminal capability
- Feature: The Node.js and Worker automator, auto, keys, ocr, barcode, qrcode, yolo, threads, continuation, timers, global selector functions and events key/touch listeners match AutoJs6 scripts, with actions and queries returning Promise values; accessibility service control, key interception, touch listening and yolo require the new accessibility.service, events.key.intercept, events.touch and yolo capabilities respectively
- Feature: The Node.js and Worker colors.theme, gallery (requires 3-Maple Image), files.batchRename (requires Batch Rename), speech.speaker, speech.diarize, speech.detectLanguage and speech.tag; the first three require declaring the new theme, gallery and batch_rename capabilities respectively, disabled by default; independently signed packaged apps cannot call 3-Maple Image or Batch Rename
- Feature: Flow objects provide await() and sync(timeout), both returning Promise values without blocking the script thread, used as await chain.sync(); exceeding timeout (milliseconds) rejects with TIMEOUT while the flow continues, as in AutoJs6 scripts
- Fix: A terminal session waitFor immediately followed by write could miss rapidly echoed output and time out
- Fix: new Worker(__filename) threw SyntaxError when the project had no package.json
- Fix: Relative paths in files.open, files.toFile and zip were not resolved against the script directory, preventing files alongside the script from being found
- Fix: Errors from Color object methods used types inconsistent with the colors module
- Improvement: When the system denies shared storage reads or writes by the files module (EACCES / EPERM), AutoJs6 shows a prompt linking to system settings to authorize Node.js Runtime ("All files access" on Android 11 or later, "Storage" on earlier versions); uncaught fs errors also trigger the prompt, at most once per execution, without changing the error itself
- Improvement: Scheduled setTimeout, setInterval and setImmediate callbacks no longer run after process.exit(), matching native Node.js
- Improvement: sysprops.getInt / getBoolean return null for missing properties, timers.setIntervalExt returns a numeric id, and task function options accept null, matching AutoJs6 scripts
- Improvement: ocr results include a read-only extras object, and option declarations include recognition options such as useOpenCL and mergeLine
- Improvement: Type declarations for speech.models.list include updateAvailable and latestVersionCode to indicate whether an installed model has a newer version (requires 3-Macaw Speech 1.4.0 or later)

APK checksums are in `SHA256SUMS`.

releases.changelogText:
* `提示` 插件改名为 Paddle OCR (PP-OCRv3 Paddle Lite), 包名改为 `io.github.supermonster003.autojs6.plugin.paddleocr.v3.paddlelite`, 插件 ID 改为 `paddle-ocr-pp-ocrv3-paddle-lite`, 变体改为 `v3-paddle-lite`; 识别功能与 1.0.6 相同
* `提示` 原名称 Paddle OCR (PP-OCRv3) 与原包名改由 ONNX Runtime 版 (2.0.0 起) 使用, 它支持 4 个 ABI, 推荐改用; 已安装的 1.0.6 之后会升级为 ONNX Runtime 版, 需要继续使用 Paddle Lite 时请另行安装本插件
* `提示` 两者可以同时安装, 脚本中可用 `ocr.paddle(img, { variant: "v3-paddle-lite" })` 指定本插件; 1.0.6 及更早的记录属于改名前的插件
* `修复` 先识别小图再识别大图时插件进程崩溃, 之后的识别全部失败的问题; 现在所有识别都在同一个固定线程上运行

* `Hint` Renamed to Paddle OCR (PP-OCRv3 Paddle Lite) with package name `io.github.supermonster003.autojs6.plugin.paddleocr.v3.paddlelite`, plugin ID `paddle-ocr-pp-ocrv3-paddle-lite`, and variant `v3-paddle-lite`; recognition works the same as in 1.0.6
* `Hint` The original name Paddle OCR (PP-OCRv3) and package name now belong to the ONNX Runtime edition (from 2.0.0), which supports four ABIs and is recommended; an installed 1.0.6 will later upgrade to the ONNX Runtime edition, so install this plugin separately to keep using Paddle Lite
* `Hint` Both can be installed at the same time, and scripts can select this plugin with `ocr.paddle(img, { variant: "v3-paddle-lite" })`; entries for 1.0.6 and earlier belong to the plugin before the rename
* `Fix` The plugin process crashed when a large image followed small ones, and every later recognition failed; all recognition now runs on one fixed thread

`SHA256SUMS` lists the digests of the APKs.

releases.changelogText:
3-Block Compose 1.9.0: 交互预览更接近真实运行, TSX 的 UI 工程, 联动编辑 UI 工程中的 Compose 界面. 交互预览中脚本弹出的对话框显示在画布内并可点按; 画布上方的 "返回键" 按钮依次交给对话框与脚本的 back_pressed 事件; 隐藏设计器时脚本收到 pause 并继续运行, 回来时收到 resume; 脚本设置的状态栏与导航栏颜色显示为画布上下的色条; 设置页新增 "主线程占用上限" (1 - 60 秒, 默认 5 秒), 脚本占用 AutoJs6 主线程过久时被停止并显示所在行. 以 "ui"; 开头的 .tsx 脚本里的 JSX 布局可以在画布上编辑 (未改动的布局原样保留, 事件桩采用能通过 TypeScript 编译的写法), 也能在交互预览中由 AutoJs6 编译后运行, 编译失败时显示行号. 用 compose.attach(ui.<id>, ...) 挂在 <compose> 容器上的 Compose 界面画在画布上, 可以点选节点并用 Compose 的面板编辑, 与布局共用撤销历史, 保存时只改写 compose.attach 的第二个参数; 组件面板新增 "Compose" 分类, 一步添加容器与 compose.attach 调用.

修复: 阿拉伯语界面中标题里的 "3-Block Compose" 不再被排成 "Block Compose-3", 示例代码与设计器中的代码改为从左到右排版.

优化: "预览差异" 按已安装的 AutoJs6 实际支持的能力列出; 没有设置高度的 <compose> 容器在布局预览中按其界面的高度占位.

依赖: 升级 ui-preview-api.aar 契约制品至 ui 预览契约 v5 (v4 追加对话框, 生命周期事件, 窗口颜色与主线程占用上限, v5 追加 TSX 运行与编译错误; 只支持 v3 或更早版本的 AutoJs6 构建仍提供原有预览).

要求: AutoJs6 6.8.0 (5322) 或更高版本中包含宿主提交 f12665ffde 的构建 (发布时 6.8.0 尚未正式发布); 设计器的 TSX 工程需要 TypeScript Engine 0.7.0; UI (XML) 工程的布局预览需要包含预览服务的 AutoJs6 构建 (宿主提交 306a8f7834 之后), 交互预览需要预览契约 v2 (宿主提交 4c332c2053 之后) 与 Android 13 或更高版本; 1.9.0 新增: 交互预览中的对话框, 返回键, 暂停与恢复, 状态栏颜色和主线程占用上限需要预览契约 v4 (宿主提交 2d7944d10 之后), 在交互预览中运行 TSX 脚本需要预览契约 v5 (宿主提交 204a33ee5 之后) 并安装 TypeScript Engine 0.7.0 或更高版本; 更早的构建上这些功能不出现, 交互预览保持 1.8.0 的做法. 插件不申请运行时权限, 不访问网络.

3-Block Compose 1.9.0: an interactive preview closer to a real run, TSX UI projects, and linked editing of Compose interfaces in UI projects. In the interactive preview, dialogs the script opens show inside the canvas and can be tapped; the "Back key" button above the canvas goes to the open dialog first, then to the script's back_pressed event; hiding the designer sends the script pause and it keeps running, and coming back sends resume; status bar and navigation bar colors set by the script show as bars at the top and bottom of the canvas; the settings page has a new "Busy main thread limit" (1 - 60 s, 5 s by default), past which AutoJs6 stops the script and shows its line. JSX layouts in .tsx scripts that start with "ui"; can be edited on the canvas (layouts that are not edited stay as they are, and event stubs are written so that TypeScript compiles them), and AutoJs6 compiles and runs them in the interactive preview, showing the line of a compile error. A Compose interface attached to a <compose> container with compose.attach(ui.<id>, ...) is drawn on the canvas, and its nodes can be selected and edited with the Compose panels, sharing the layout's undo history; saving rewrites only the second argument of compose.attach. A new "Compose" category in the palette adds a container and its compose.attach call in one step.

Fixes: in Arabic, "3-Block Compose" in titles no longer shows as "Block Compose-3", and code in the examples and the designer is laid out left to right.

Improvements: "preview differences" follow what the installed AutoJs6 supports; a <compose> container without a height of its own takes the height of its interface in the layout preview.

Dependency: upgrades the ui-preview-api.aar contract artifact to ui preview contract v5 (v4 adds dialogs, lifecycle events, window colors and the busy main thread limit, v5 adds TSX runs and compile errors; AutoJs6 builds with v3 or older keep the earlier previews).

Requirements: an AutoJs6 6.8.0 (5322) or later build that contains host commit f12665ffde (6.8.0 was not yet officially released at publication); TSX projects in the designer need TypeScript Engine 0.7.0; the layout preview of UI (XML) projects needs an AutoJs6 build with the preview service (host commit 306a8f7834 or later), and their interactive preview needs preview contract v2 (host commit 4c332c2053 or later) and Android 13 or later; new in 1.9.0: dialogs, the back key, pause and resume, status bar colors and the busy main thread limit in the interactive preview need preview contract v4 (host commit 2d7944d10 or later), and running TSX scripts in the interactive preview needs preview contract v5 (host commit 204a33ee5 or later) with TypeScript Engine 0.7.0 or later installed; with older builds these features do not appear and the interactive preview works as in 1.8.0. The plugin requests no runtime permission and has no network access.

Version: **v1.9.0 (219)**. Checksums: `SHA256SUMS`.

items.author: SuperMonster003

releases.changelogText:
3-Macaw Speech 1.4.0

Official APKs signed with the AutoJs6 release certificate.

Source: `feebf11a82c8129dcca6a36bd839c2eb00cb43b7`

Published release.

- Audio playback on Try it out: file recognition now plays the file, with a seek bar, speeds from 0.5x to 2x and 5 second skips. The sentence you hear lights up and stays in view, a tap on a sentence plays from there, and a lyrics view shows the current sentence in large type, for speakers, languages and sound tags too. The latest result can still be played after you leave the page, as long as the file is there: the plugin keeps read access to that one file until you clear it or pick another.
- Model updates: when a newer version of an installed model is available, its card on the home screen says "Update available (v2)" and one tap updates it. The new version is downloaded and checked first, so a failed or paused update leaves the old one working, and a model in use can be updated too. Scripts see `updateAvailable` and `latestVersionCode` in `speech.models.list()`, and `speech.models.install()` updates.
- Language identification goes sentence by sentence: when a recording mixes languages, Try it out, `speech.detectLanguage` and the `speech_detect_language` tool show the language of each sentence (very short sentences join a neighbor). The overall language is the one spoken longest. Each sentence takes its own pass, so this is somewhat slower than in 1.3.0.
- Fixes: after deleting or replacing a speech synthesis model, other models could lose most of the text they read aloud, without any error, until the plugin restarted; opening the plugin from the system's text-to-speech settings left the list one row above the synthesis group; and while a model downloaded, its total showed twice the real size, because unpacking was counted in. The home screen and the notification now show the download against the model's size, then the installation on its own.
- Evaluated, not adopted: recognition on the phone's NPU (speech under 8 seconds got slower, only recent Qualcomm flagship phones can use it, and the APK and the models would grow a lot) and sherpa-onnx 2.0 (it drops eSpeak NG, and 10 of the 13 speech synthesis models went silent or skipped words). Recognition stays on the CPU and the speech runtime on sherpa-onnx 1.13.8.
- `speech.detectLanguage` and its tool still need the AutoJs6 6.8.0 release, as in 1.3.0; with an older AutoJs6 (internal build 5456 or later, as in 1.0.0), everything else above works, because it runs in the plugin itself.
- The model catalog is unchanged (version 3, the signed `speech-models-v3` of AutoJs6-Shared-Assets).
- No new permissions.
- Choose the APK of your device's processor (most phones: `arm64-v8a`), or `universal` for every device.
- See the [changelog](https://github.com/SuperMonster003/AutoJs6-Plugin-Three-Macaw-Speech/blob/v1.4.0/app/src/main/assets/doc/CHANGELOG-en.md) and the [README](https://github.com/SuperMonster003/AutoJs6-Plugin-Three-Macaw-Speech/blob/v1.4.0/.readme/README-en.md).

License: the plugin's source code is under the MPL-2.0. `libsherpa-onnx-jni.so` statically links eSpeak NG and UCD Tools (GPL-3.0-or-later), so the APKs as a whole are conveyed under the GPL-3.0-or-later, without any warranty. The corresponding source of the speech runtime is attached as `autojs6-plugin-three-macaw-speech-corresponding-source-sherpa-onnx-v1.13.8-ac68c80b.tar`: the sherpa-onnx v1.13.8 source with its build scripts and every dependency archive that its build pins by URL and SHA-256 (unchanged since 1.0.0).

APK and source archive checksums are in `SHA256SUMS`.

releases.changelogText:
3-Stove Agent 1.3.0

Official APKs signed with the AutoJs6 release certificate.

Source: `51b4ae666a0225a99ef3e592b37e32e4c1071e4a`

Published release.

- Feature: ai.agent task controls, events and registered-script context/results for Node.js, Bun and Workers, with explicit authorization for packaged applications (Requires AutoJs6 6.8.0 build 5850; packaged applications authorize access in the host, while 3-Stove Agent still runs the task loop)
- Feature: Configurable risk recognition: a new Risk recognition settings screen adds your own package names and keywords on top of the packaged payment app list (Alipay, AlipayHK, UnionPay, PayPal, Google Wallet, Samsung Pay, Huawei Wallet, Mi Pay) and the ten-language sensitive keyword table; additions only widen the lists and apply at once, and matching screen actions become sensitive and go through confirmation
- Feature: Floating ball redesign: the compact ball shows the task and its current step on two lines and tapping the text opens a step timeline card; the control card is condensed to the same two rows as the workbench (preset, model and access above the goal field, voice and start), with the model and access mode switched inside the overlay and shared with the app; the timeline follows new steps while you are at the end, pauses when you scroll up and resumes at the end, as does the task details screen
- Feature: Preset import / export: the presets screen gains Import JSON and Export JSON; the exported file carries every preset's configuration but no model, each imported preset is reviewed one by one with a replace notice for an existing name, tool groups or script directories missing on this device are dropped, and a pending review survives leaving the screen
- Feature: Observation tools completed: the read-only tools app_list (installed applications, optionally filtered by a package name or label fragment, at most 200 rows), app_installed (whether a package is installed) and script_list (script executions currently running in AutoJs6 with their ids and states, for use with script_stop) map to package_manager.listApps, app.isInstalled and engines.list, which the host grant already allowed; they join the observation and script groups and are enabled by default
- Feature: Plan mode (a preset switch, off by default; scripts can override it with options.plan): the model first proposes 3 to 8 steps, the workbench, floating ball and confirmation screen show an editable plan review card, and after approval the runtime passes the plan to the model with every prompt and expects it to be followed in order; when the plan stops fitting, the model proposes a new one for another review; the decision schema gains a plan branch accepted only in plan mode, and the timeline and history record the plan steps
- Feature: Task result sharing: the task detail menu gains Share summary, which hands the system share sheet plain text with the goal, the state and summary, the evidence and the unfinished work; observations, arguments, script results and error details never leave the private history, and the item stays disabled while a task is still running
- Feature: Task alerts keep Failure alerts and Completion notifications in two compact summary rows, each opening independent notification, toast and dialog switches. New defaults enable all three for failures and notification plus toast for completion; saved choices are preserved. Normal completion, including a partial result without an error, alerts once; cancellation and history replay stay silent
- Feature: Unify standalone settings with flat groups, consistent rows and centered rounded dialogs. Language, night mode, theme color and launcher icon changes apply only after OK; Cancel leaves saved values unchanged. Theme color follows AutoJs6 by default, with a shared palette, HEX/RGB input and a local preview. Neutral surfaces keep stable colors and controls follow the selected theme. The launcher default is adaptive automatic, while upgrades preserve explicit saved choices.
- Feature: Voice input can use 3-Macaw Speech offline recognition directly: with 3-Macaw Speech installed, the microphone opens it by default instead of asking every time which recognizer app to use; a new "Prefer 3-Macaw Speech offline recognition" switch in Settings (shown only when 3-Macaw Speech is installed) lets the system choose again when turned off. On devices without a recognizer app, the settings note also suggests installing 3-Macaw Speech and downloading a recognition model to recognize speech offline
- Feature: Works as a target of the 3-Macaw Speech digital assistant: after speaking to 3-Macaw Speech (for example by long-pressing the power button), tap "3-Stove Agent" and the recognized text becomes a task draft, filled into the floating ball card while the ball is on screen (replacing any earlier draft) and opened in the workbench otherwise; nothing runs until you review it and tap Start, so a misheard word never turns into an action on the phone
- Feature: Resident listening (a new switch in Settings, off by default, needs 3-Macaw Speech with its wake word and recognition models): say a wake word ("小炉小炉" or "Hey Stove" by default, up to five of your own, three sensitivity levels) and then the task, and the sentence becomes a draft: in the floating ball card while the ball is on screen, otherwise in the workbench, or as a notification on the lock screen or without the overlay permission; it runs only after you tap Start. 3-Macaw Speech records and this plugin asks for no microphone permission. Only one of 3-Stone AI, 3-Stove Agent and 3-Macaw Speech can listen resident at a time; the switch names the app that already does and opens its settings. While on, 3-Stove Agent and 3-Macaw Speech each keep a notification and battery use rises. It never starts at boot: opening the workbench or Settings resumes it, and after a reboot or an update a reminder offers to resume (the new RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED permission only posts that reminder)
- Feature: Resident listening can be time-limited: below its switch, Settings adds "Listening time" (turn off after 10 / 30 / 60 minutes, or always on, the default) and "Listen only while charging" (off by default). When the time is up the switch turns off and the ongoing notification goes away; the notification and Settings show when that happens, and after a reboot or an update past that time the switch is simply off, without a resume reminder. Only while charging: unplugging pauses it and 3-Macaw Speech stops recording; plugging in continues. From Android 14 the system does not allow reopening the microphone in the background, so the notification then says "Tap to continue listening"; tapping it or opening the workbench or Settings continues
- Feature: Tasks can use tools offered by AutoJs6 plugins: the tools that enabled plugins (for example 3-Macaw Speech) bring join the tool list when a task starts, so the agent can listen to a sentence, read text aloud or transcribe an audio file. Tool groups in settings gain "Plugin tools" (read-only, on by default, also turned on when upgrading) and "Plugin tools (write)" (writes files, off by default, confirmed before every call); output files without a chosen location are saved under plugin-outputs in the working directory. Tasks that use a local model (including when Automatic picks one) run without plugin tools, because their definitions do not fit a local model's input. Requires the AutoJs6 6.8.0 release
- Fix: The send button no longer stays on the first line of a multi-line goal; it sits at the bottom like the microphone button
- Fix: In plan mode the plan request no longer offers tool definitions to online models with native tool calling, so the model can only return a plan instead of calling a tool (on a real device a Codex-style model answered with tool calls three times in a row and the task failed with DECISION_UNPARSABLE); native tool calling resumes once the plan is approved
- Fix: Native tool-calling continuation rounds no longer inherit the remainder of the first request's model timeout: every round (the model returns tool calls, the tools run, the next request goes out) gets the full model timeout again, and the whole turn is bounded only by the run duration budget and the round cap. On a real device, native tasks longer than 5 minutes (for example reading a calculator after several screen captures) ended at exactly 300 s with MODEL_TIMEOUT. Needs a host newer than AutoJs6 5298 and a 3-Stone AI newer than 1.2.1, which reset per round the same way
- Fix: The Floating ball checkbox in the More menu now follows the app theme color
- Fix: Keep the automatic launcher icon resource dynamic after installation so launchers can load the matching light or dark variant.
- Fix: A run query could briefly report a terminal state without its result while the task was finishing (an occasional failure of the fake-host conformance suite on remote CI): the terminal state is now archived together with the result, so hosts and scripts never see a finished task without one
- Fix: Complete missing translations in update settings
- Fix: In the Arabic interface, 3-Stove Agent no longer appears reversed as Stove Agent-3
- Fix: Links in the release history now show only their text instead of raw Markdown and the web address (in Arabic that text appeared out of order)
- Fix: "Open AutoJs6" on the workbench did nothing when AutoJs6 was already open; the connection request now always reaches AutoJs6. When this plugin is unavailable (for example disabled in Plugin Center or not yet authorized), AutoJs6 opens Plugin Center at 3-Stove Agent instead of showing a dialog (this part needs the AutoJs6 6.8.0 release)
- Fix: With the default tool groups, tasks on a local model no longer fail with LIMIT_EXCEEDED before the first model call: the local model's prompt states the rules for registered scripts more briefly and leaves them out while no script is registered, and the plan rules appear only in plan mode
- Improvement: The Retry with another model buttons are gone (the model is switched at the top of the workbench or inside the floating ball); the floating ball keeps Task history and Open workbench in its More menu; the history icon uses the standard glyph
- Improvement: After an MCP server sends tools/list_changed, the frozen tool definitions are re-verified before the next call: unchanged definitions keep working, and only a changed one fails with MCP_CATALOG_CHANGED and tells the model to have the user refresh the tool selection in MCP settings and start a new task; the endpoint note now says OAuth sign-in and the older HTTP+SSE transport are not supported
- Improvement: The one-time migration introduced in 1.2.0 is gone: an old model choice in the workbench draft preferences is no longer moved into model-selection.json, so a choice saved by an earlier version has to be picked again on the workbench
- Improvement: The "Enable voice input" switch in Settings now explains itself: the microphone appears only when a speech recognizer app is installed, recognition runs in that app and this plugin records nothing; on devices without one (some Chinese ROMs, for example) the reason is shown right there instead of the workbench silently lacking the microphone after the switch is turned on
- Improvement: The plugin center is the sole enable switch. Official packages enable automatically after installation without a confirmation dialog, while explicit disable choices remain. Script and standalone entry points connect on demand; no boot startup or task replay is added
- Improvement: Keep the About icon in a rounded frame while its transparent interior reveals the surrounding page background. Show the launcher icon choices from the top with smaller explanatory notes.
- Improvement: When a task fails because the host fused the model source (RATE_LIMITED: FUSED), the result now explains the cause and what to do (wait and retry, restart AutoJs6 if it keeps failing); the host now also lifts the fuse automatically once the timed-out blocking transaction returns, so later tasks need no restart
- Improvement: Consistent visual sizing for launcher and Plugin Center icons, with transparent backgrounds and neutral black, white or grayscale artwork
- Improvement: Plugin Center icons use the sizes, positions, light and dark artwork, and circular backgrounds adjusted in Icon Studio, retaining reproducible sources and parameters
- Improvement: Android App info icons share Icon Studio artwork and light/dark backgrounds while preserving transparent Plugin Center artwork and existing launcher choices
- Improvement: When a task fails because its content is larger than the model input limit (LIMIT_EXCEEDED), the result adds one line of sizes: the total request bytes, the limit that applied, and the bytes of each part such as the system prompt, tool descriptions, the task text and observations, so you can see which part is too large; the line holds only numbers and tool group names, never the task text, screen content or memories

releases.changelogText:
TypeScript Engine 0.7.0

Official APKs signed with the AutoJs6 release certificate.

Source: `1e92487b638d0e24b641acbe0d30c9c0d644b53e`

Published release. Changes since 0.6.3:

- Feature: TypeScript syntax tree parsing service (`org.autojs.plugin.typescript.PARSER`) for plugins such as the 3-Block Compose designer to parse a single .ts / .tsx / .js file: syntax analysis only, returning the syntax tree with source positions and the syntax errors, without type checking or compilation, and never queuing behind or ahead of the compiler service
- Improvement: TypeScript / TSX declarations and argument checks for compose.memo
- Improvement: TypeScript / TSX properties, slots and event declarations for Compose UI V2 components
- Improvement: compose.dialog returns an updatable, closable session for dialogs and modal bottom sheets in UI or ordinary scripts
- Improvement: Compose UI TSX: XML `<compose>` containers and compose.attach embed independent Compose sessions in UI pages or legacy floating windows; compose.AndroidView embeds an existing Android View or one returned by a synchronous factory
- Improvement: Rhino projects recognize Compose UI TSX component properties and callbacks; legacy XML TSX remains available
- Improvement: Android App info icons share Icon Studio artwork and light/dark backgrounds while preserving transparent Plugin Center artwork and existing launcher choices
- Hint: the parsing service loads its own copy of TypeScript on first use (about 1 second) and releases it after about 1 minute idle or when the system is low on memory; 3-Block Compose 1.4.0 TSX projects require TypeScript Engine 0.7.0
- Hint: the Compose features above need an AutoJs6 6.8.0 host build (5320 - 5323 depending on the feature; 6.8.0 was not yet officially released at publication)

APK checksums are in `SHA256SUMS`.
